Maps show where heavy rainfall poses flood risks across Northeast US

2026-07-29 CBS News flood maps, rainfall, Northeast US, National Weather Service, flood watches, flash flooding, weather mapping
Read the source article

Quick summary

CBS News maps the flood risk across the northeastern United States as over 10 million people face flood alerts, with Albany, NY receiving over 6 inches of rain and 84 flash flood reports across the region.

Key takeaways

  • Over 10 million people were under flood alerts across the northeastern US as a storm system moved into New England.
  • Flood watches covered large areas of New York, Connecticut, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, and Vermont.
  • Albany, NY received over 6 inches of rain—the highest total—triggering flash flood warnings.
  • 84 flash flood reports were recorded across the eastern US in a 48-hour period.
  • CBS News used maps to visualize the geographic extent of flood risk, demonstrating the role of cartography in weather communication.
